name: app-starter-template
purpose: Canonical AI-readable starter source for populating newly created empty application repositories and for continued maintenance.

deploymentPolicy.instruction: The user creates a new empty repository and provides its URL plus application requirements. The AI must complete the bootstrap protocol first, infer the required composition, populate the required starter and handoff files, and only then implement application-specific features. Do not ask the user to use GitHub's Use this template flow unless they explicitly prefer it.

selectionPolicy.instruction: Infer the required template composition from the application requirements. Always start with core and add only the extensions actually needed.

rules.cloudflare-worker: Add when server-side HTTP/API processing or Cloudflare Worker functionality is required.
rules.d1: Add when Cloudflare D1 persistence is required. Also apply cloudflare-worker.
rules.sheets-gas: Add when Google Sheets or Google Apps Script integration is required.
